exposure: hematological parameters and indices (HPI) from full blood count (FBC) on the first day of life (D1)
cohort: 206 preterm infants with gestational age below 30 weeks.
finding: Hematological parameters and indices (HPI) from full blood count (FBC) collected on the first day of life (D1) are not associated with the occurrence of intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) and cannot be used as predictors in extremely premature infants.
